_comment: The recurring jobs a fresh installation gets from `jori setup` (lib/onboarding/core.mjs installStarterSchedule). Only jobs that work with the core alone: a Claude sign-in, the local memory and the watchdog. Every other job in system/tasks.json waits until its integration is set up and is then turned on from the control room's Schedule page. A name is a task in system/tasks.json (schedule and trigger_script come from there); an entry with its own `script` is a crontab line with no task of its own. Lines are tagged `# jori-starter` and a job whose `--label` is already in the crontab is never added twice.

jobs.name: watchdog
jobs.label: watchdog
jobs.why: Keeps the agents healthy and notices failing jobs

jobs.why: Writes down what it noticed each day
